_description: Global model map: when compat=openai_chat, Anthropic model names are converted to OpenAI model names.
_precedence: This map applies globally. A token-level model_map overrides it. With no hit, default_model applies, falling back to gpt-5.4.
_allowed_models_note: Configurable extension of the compat target-model allowlist, unioned with the built-in allowlist (the built-in set is the lower bound and cannot be emptied). Add new upstream models here — no code change needed.
